auxiliary_scripts.trace_inventory:
require_relative "../../benchmarks/load"
require "active_support/notifications"

fields = Hash.new { |hash, name| hash[name] = [] }
subscriber = ActiveSupport::Notifications.subscribe(/\.onni\z/) do |*arguments|
  event = ActiveSupport::Notifications::Event.new(*arguments)
  fields[event.name] |= event.payload.keys.map(&:to_s)
end
Onni::Bench::Load.with_registry! do
  Onni::Bench::Load.prepare_features!
  Onni.configuration.stats_sample_rate = 1.0
  Onni.show!(:flag_boolean)
  Onni.show_actor!(:flag_actor, Onni::Bench::Load.actor_class.new(0, beta_tester: true))
  Onni.show_group!(:flag_group, :staff)
  Onni.show_percentage!(:flag_percentage, 50)
  Onni.variants!(:flag_variant, control: 50, treatment: 50)
  Onni.show?(:flag_boolean)
  Onni.purge_stats!(older_than: Time.now + 3600)
end
ActiveSupport::Notifications.unsubscribe(subscriber)
File.write("benchmarks/output/show_skip_trace_inventory.json", JSON.pretty_generate(fields.transform_values(&:sort)) + "\n")
puts JSON.generate(event_names: fields.keys.sort, payload_values_saved: false)
auxiliary_scripts.package_compare:
require "open3"
require "json"
require "fileutils"
require "digest"

root = Dir.pwd
results = {"samples" => 3, "source_date_epoch" => "1794528000", "raw" => {}}
{"before" => "tmp/pressure-show-skip/baseline", "after" => "."}.each do |label, directory|
  destination = File.expand_path("tmp/pressure-show-skip/packages/#{label}", root)
  FileUtils.mkdir_p(destination)
  results["raw"][label] = Array.new(3) do |index|
    path = File.join(destination, "onni-#{index}.gem")
    output, status = Open3.capture2e({"SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH" => results["source_date_epoch"]}, "gem", "build", "onni.gemspec", "--output", path, chdir: directory)
    raise "Package build failed" unless status.success?
    {"bytes" => File.size(path), "sha256" => Digest::SHA256.file(path).hexdigest}
  end
end
results["summary_max_bytes"] = results["raw"].transform_values { |rows| rows.map { |row| row.fetch("bytes") }.max }
File.write("benchmarks/output/show_skip_package_compare.json", JSON.pretty_generate(results) + "\n")
puts JSON.generate(results["summary_max_bytes"])
